scope: paired exploratory development evaluation, not independent held-out testing

provenance.selection: first two rows per claim-language x booklet-language x gold-label cell in the frozen grouped 81-case plan

definitions.raw_label_accuracy: gold-matching recognised raw NLI label, regardless of later submission-contract acceptance
definitions.strict_accuracy: gold-matching label after successful official submission-output rendering; failures remain in the denominator
definitions.valid_output_rate: successful official submission-output rendering after identity, evidence and citation checks
definitions.native_json_rate: parseable JSON with a recognised raw label and no deterministic syntax recovery; not full contract validity
definitions.citation_verification: mechanical supplied-source provenance, not independently annotated semantic sufficiency

dense-v1.description: original claim-only dense Top-5, original prompt and generated-snippet citation handling

vote-aware-v1.description: vote-plus-claim dense Top-5, vote-attribution instructions, source IDs and strict identity/evidence validation

candidate_failure_audit.interpretation: Identity validation is the immediate rejection gate, but wrong labels and wrong-scope retrieval mean rejected answers cannot be assumed otherwise valid.

representative_cases.observation: Selected pages explicitly name the requested premium-relief initiative; the identity rejection blocks final citation acceptance despite a gold-matching raw label.
All five selected passages concern the Climate and Innovation Act rather than the requested COVID-19 amendment, showing a retrieval-scope failure alongside missing identity fields.
Several selected passages explicitly identify the cash initiative, but the response rejects the identity and gives an incorrect raw label for an unrelated tax claim.

limitations: small exploratory sample with correlated examples and shared PDFs
retrieval query, prompt, response schema, identity gate and citation mechanism changed together
single remote call per case and arm; latency does not establish computational efficiency
